# SmartTab AI

> AI-powered Chrome extension that automatically organizes browser tabs, surfaces relevant content, and archives unused tabs.

SmartTab AI uses machine learning to observe browsing patterns, predict which tabs you'll need next, and quietly archive the ones you won't — with zero manual organization required. Includes cross-device sync, context awareness, and a privacy-first data model.
